title: feat(lint): warn on a credential-shaped literal in a connector's header or env map
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9QkrVNjxTuWMqLuQJ2j3ycU)_
Fixes #29341

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Three new exports on the `@objectstack/lint` entry and a new advisory on the connector save door; nothing is refused or narrowed.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：连接器四个请求头/环境变量映射（`providerConfig.headers`、`defaultHeaders`、`transport.headers`、`transport.env`）里写死的疑似凭据，`os validate` / `os build` / `os lint` 与连接器保存都会给出警告，指向 `auth.credentialRef`。
- 为什么改：执行 #28640 裁决 ①A（记录 6566912252）：这些映射读取时整块隐去，但写死的密钥仍存在元数据里；作者在写的时候就该被提醒。
- 风险与回滚：只是警告，任何保存都不会被拒；判定沿用流程规则那套启发式，误报只多一行提示。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/lint/src/lint-connector-credential-literals.ts`（规则与措辞，尤其 stdio 那一句）、`packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts` 新条目、`packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.ts` 新增的 `connector` 映射行。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/lint-connector-credential-literals.test.ts`，预期 16 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **New advisory rule `connector-credential-literal`** (`packages/lint/src/lint-connector-credential-literals.ts`). It asks the existing `isCredentialShapedLiteral` predicate (`credential-literal.ts`, unchanged, no second name list) over each declarative connector entry's four maps: `providerConfig.headers`, `providerConfig.defaultHeaders`, `providerConfig.transport.headers`, `providerConfig.transport.env`. One `warning` per credential-shaped literal, located by path (`connectors[i].providerConfig.defaultHeaders["X-Api-Key"]`), never echoing the value.
- **Wording.** Header maps: `header 'NAME' in MAP holds a credential-shaped literal, kept in metadata, not the secrets layer; move it to the connector's auth.credentialRef`, with a fix line naming the `bearer` / `api-key` auth variants. The `transport.env` map gets a different steer, because a stdio MCP server takes no `auth` (see Acceptance notes): `… a stdio server takes no auth; auth.credentialRef reaches it only over http`.
- **Registry entry** in `AUTHORING_RULES`: `tier: 'advisory'`, all three commands (`validate`, `build`, `lint`), `surfaces: CLI_AND_RUNTIME`, `runtimeTypes: ['connector']`.
- **Save door.** `TYPE_TO_STACK_KEY` gains `connector: 'connectors'`, so a `PUT /meta/connector/:name` publish runs the rule through the existing runtime authoring gate and the findings ride the save response's `advisories` (the channel `flow-credential-literal` already uses). No new channel was built.
- **`os explain connector-credential-literal`** entry in `rule-explanations.ts`: the four maps, why withholding on read does not move the value out of metadata, the auth variants, the stdio limit, why it only warns.
- Barrel exports `lintConnectorCredentialLiterals`, `CONNECTOR_CREDENTIAL_LITERAL`, `ConnectorCredentialLiteralFinding`.
- Changeset `.changeset/29341-connector-credential-literal.md` (`@objectstack/lint` patch).

**Forced edits (not tests):** the four CLI transcripts that print `Running author-time rules (N)` go 60 → 61 (`content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`, `deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`, `getting-started/build-with-claude-code.mdx`, `ui/react-pages.mdx`), because the registry gained one entry (`check:docs-transcript-drift`). No existing test was edited.

Not touched: the connector redactor (`connector-credential-redaction.ts`), the package export path (#29342), `credential-literal.ts`, anything in `packages/spec`.

## Tests

- `packages/lint/src/lint-connector-credential-literals.test.ts` (16): a `Bearer …` literal in each of the four maps warns at its own path; a credential name alone warns; `Accept: application/json`, an `auth.credentialRef`-routed connector, a template, a blank and a non-string value draw nothing; values outside the four maps are not this rule's; malformed stacks never throw; **the four maps equal the connector redactor's withheld maps**, read through the public `getMetadataTypeRedactor('connector')`; registry entry shape; CLI commands and runtime gate report warnings only; `stackKeyForType('connector') === 'connectors'`; barrel; `os explain` names every map.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts`, new block (2), through the real `saveMetaItem`: LIT saves of a `rest`, an `mcp` http and an `mcp` stdio connector each land (rows stored, literal at rest unchanged) and carry one `warning` advisory per map on the 2xx, with no sentinel in the response; DARK (credentialRef-routed, `Accept` only) carries none.
- `packages/cli/test/connector-credential-literal-doors.e2e.test.ts` (2, nightly integration tier like its flow sibling): `os validate --json` and `os lint --json` exit 0 on LIT with the four warnings, and print none on DARK.

## Acceptance notes

- **The stdio steer departs from the ruling's phrasing on purpose, and stays inside its letter.** ①A says the warning names "the literal and the `auth.credentialRef` route". Measured: the MCP provider folds a resolved `auth` into an http transport's headers only (`connector-mcp/src/mcp-provider.ts` `applyAuthToHeaders`, "Not applied to stdio transports"), the stdio client receives `transport.env` as its environment, and the connector guide says "Credentials for a stdio server ride `transport.env`, not `auth`". A plain "move it to `auth.credentialRef`" on an env entry would point at a route the runtime does not deliver for stdio. So the env warning names `auth.credentialRef` with its condition (an http transport). Flagged to the seat as an open question.
- A TypeScript config that writes `env: { TOKEN: process.env.TOKEN }` for a stdio server is evaluated to a literal before the rule reads it, so it warns at `os validate` too. That is the heuristic's accepted false-positive cost (a line of reading); nothing is refused.
- The rule's four-map list is a mirror of the spec's `CONNECTOR_CREDENTIAL_MAP_PATHS`, which the spec does not export (ruling ③A keeps it off the spec export contract). The equality is pinned by test through the public redactor API instead of an import.
- A save of the served form (maps withheld) carries the maps forward after the gate runs, so a round trip re-warns nothing; only a map the author actually sends is judged.

## Verification

All readings on head `28b45f8e` (this branch with `origin/main` merged), container-local.

<details><summary>Tests</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: Test Files 190 passed (190), Tests 7846 passed (7846).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test`: Test Files 304 passed, 4 skipped (308); Tests 22155 passed, 26 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit test/explain-rule-id.test.ts`: 14/14 (every `os explain` entry, the new one included).
- `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly … --project integration test/connector-credential-literal-doors.e2e.test.ts test/flow-credential-literal-doors.e2e.test.ts`: 2 files, 4/4.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 14 generated artifacts up to date.
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (each leg: mutate through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, rebuild lint, dist pre-flight, run, restore, rebuild, pre-flight --absent)</summary>

- **A1, nothing is refused.** Rule severity mutated to `error`. Lint unit: 3 red (warning assertions; runtime gate "never errors"). Save door: LIT red with `connector/vendor_api failed author-time validation: 2 issues — … [connector-credential-literal]`, the 422 the pin forbids. Restored: blob == HEAD, dist marker absent.
- **A2, a non-credential header draws nothing.** The predicate call replaced with "any string". Lint unit: 6 red (Accept and routed connector now warn, LIT paths 8 instead of 4). Save door: LIT and DARK red. Restored.
- **A3, the save door is wired.** The `connector: 'connectors'` row renamed. Lint unit: 2 red (`stackKeyForType` null, rule not run at the gate). Save door: LIT red (`expected [] to deeply equal [ …(4) ]`). Restored.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 90 families on `28b45f8e`; all 90 ran, all exit 0. Five first answered exit 3 (prerequisite not met: a shallow-clone pinned commit, client-react and full package dists, and one queued behind my own build) and were re-run green after `git fetch` of the pinned commit and a full `turbo run build --filter=./packages/**`. `--ran` reconciliation: 90 derived, 90 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

</details>

Dogfood battery: not owed (no `!` in the title, no `(narrowing)` arm).
